def extract_time(value):
    time_pattern = r'(\d{2}:\d{2})'
    departure_time = re.search(time_pattern, value)
    if not departure_time:
        return None
    arrival_time = re.search(time_pattern, value.split('-')[1])
    if not arrival_time:
        return None
    departure_datetime = datetime.datetime.strptime(departure_time.group(0), '%H:%M')
    arrival_datetime = datetime.datetime.strptime(arrival_time.group(0), '%H:%M')
    duration = (arrival_datetime - departure_datetime).total_seconds() / 60
    if duration < 0:
        return f"Flight {value} has unrealistic duration."
    return None
